data.name: PortableTerms
data.value: Before you start — the short version: no account, nothing installed, nothing left behind. This session is attended only, its code works once and dies when the session ends, and you can STOP it at any time. You are responsible for what the person you let in does with the access you give them; DeskGuest is provided as-is. Showing your code records your acceptance of these claims and of the full Terms.

data.name: TakeoverGroupIntro
data.value: While your AI is working, you can use the mouse and keyboard whenever you like — your AI carries on alongside you, and moving the mouse or typing never takes over. Taking over is deliberate: press Ctrl + Alt + Shift + Backspace, and hand control back from the session pill when you are done. STOP always ends the session right away, whatever you choose here.
